detail.longDescription: Remember Grok Bot, where you could create different AI characters and chat with them? OpenMausBot takes a similar idea and turns it into something you can actually run and build on your desktop. It’s an independent, open-source project inspired by Grok Bot https:// firethering.com/openmausbot-gr ok-bot-alternative/ # opensource # openai # grok # chatgpt # claude # grok # technology # ai # software
